title: Rate Note on Pause Months Charged Under the Workplace Cafe Management Program
content:
Where two or more suspension requests stand approved on the contract and the suspended days counted exceed the shortest suspension printed against the service model, every whole thirty days of suspended time counted is a month of pause charged and any part beyond them is a further month. The months of pause charged on a Workplace Cafe Management Program contract rest on that basis and on the two bases set out below.

1. Where two or more suspension requests stand approved on the contract and the suspended days counted exceed the shortest suspension printed against the service model, every whole thirty days of suspended time counted is a month of pause charged and any part beyond them is a further month.
2. Where the suspended days counted do not exceed the shortest suspension printed against the service model, the pause is handled as ordinary closed days and no month of pause is charged.
3. Otherwise, the suspended days counted are divided by thirty and rounded down to a whole month with a minimum of one.

The suspension requests standing approved are those on the contract's service request log. The shortest suspension is the figure printed against the service model the contract is held in.

**Illustration on hypothetical suspended time.** Take a hypothetical shortest suspension printed against the service model of 6 calendar days. With two approved suspension requests standing and 64 suspended days counted, the suspended days counted exceed 6: two whole thirty day periods, being 60 days, are two months of pause charged, and the 4 days beyond them are a further month, so the months of pause charged are 3. With a single approved suspension request standing and the same 64 suspended days counted, 64 divided by thirty and rounded down to a whole month is 2, the minimum of one does not bite, and the months of pause charged are 2. On each side of the shortest suspension: with 6 suspended days counted the suspended days counted do not exceed 6, the pause is handled as ordinary closed days and no month of pause is charged, while with 7 suspended days counted they do exceed it.
